title: LocuCore
description: Manage your favorite waypoints in a very simple way!
body:
![LocuCore logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37e01d38b9915055b7f5983731b66adf43cb8358.png) # Intro LocuCore is a management plugin designed for saving, managing, and teleporting to user‑saved waypoints. The experience is enhanced by an interactive and easy‑to‑understand GUI. # Social
# Commands - Help Command ``` /luc help ``` Shows the list of commands - Set Commands ``` /luc set ``` Useful if you want to set your exact position in that moment ``` /luc set ``` Universal set command - Remove Command ``` /luc remove ``` Remove a specific waypoint - Tp Command ``` /luc tp ``` Teleport a specific player to a waypoint - Edit Commands ``` /luc edit coordinates ``` Useful if you want to change the coordinates with your exact position in that moment ``` /luc edit coordinates ``` Universal command to modify the coordinates of a specific waypoint ``` /luc edit owner ``` Useful if you want to pass the property of the waypoint to another player ``` /luc edit public ``` Command to change the visibility of your waypoint ``` /luc edit name ``` Command to change the name of your waypoint - Menu Command ``` /luc menu ``` It opens a useful GUI to simplify the previous commands ![LocuCore GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e8b695f3667576fd6285d5c17d95faa0081b7d3_0.webp) # Permission - locucore.set - locucore.remove - locucore.tp - locucore.edit - locucore.rank.admin # Found bugs? Please report it now at this link! Thank you so much ^^ [Bug Report](https://github.com/Tuberoh/LocuCore/issues)
